research_rationale:
EO 11701 (38 FR 2675, signed 1973-01-24) has five sections: (1) the Secretary of Labor shall issue rules requiring each executive department and agency to list suitable employment openings with the State Employment Service or the United States Employment Service, in consultation with the Civil Service Commission; (2) the Secretary of Labor is designated and empowered to exercise, without presidential approval, the President's authority under section 2012 of title 38, United States Code (now 38 U.S.C. 4212); (3) the Secretary of Labor shall gather information on the effectiveness of the program and report to the President from time to time; (4) agencies shall issue procurement rule amendments in consultation with the Secretary and cooperate with and comply with the Secretary's rules; (5) Executive Order No. 11598 of June 16, 1971 is superseded. The dossier inventory omitted section 1, so it is corrected to the five sections of the order. Section 5 supersedes EO 11598 and was carried out when the order issued on 1973-01-24. Sections 1 to 4 have no sunset, condition or own-terms end. The held U.S. Code text of 38 U.S.C. 4212 prints Ex. Ord. No. 11701 in its notes, the held eCFR text of 20 CFR 654.8 (amended through 2026-10-30) refers to the mandatory listing program provided by 38 U.S.C. 2012 and Executive Order 11701, the held 48 CFR 22.1300 (through 2026-10-19) lists Executive Order 11701 among the sources of the veterans employment rules, and 31 CFR 202.4 and 203.6 cite it. the bounded machine searches current-law:usc, current-law:ecfr and later-events:ofr_catalog were read for coverage and found no amendment, revocation or supersession of EO 11701.
